facts.fact: The FY2025 finance law (decree 24-186/PR of 19 December 2024) appropriates KMF 73,000,000, wholly as a transfer (subvention), to the chambre du Numerique under the posts, telecommunications and digital economy ministry; the amount was unchanged by the 2025 rectificative.

note: No rose/fell: the record calls the body new in FY2025 yet prints a 73,000,000 comparator for 2024, which is unclear.
